title: Budget Buddy v1.5.5
release_notes:
## What's Changed in Budget Buddy v1.5.5

### Features
- add budget AI assistant widget, home shell, and profile settings screen
- add profile settings, splash, update dialog, and auth screens
- add expense tracker and profile settings screens
- add core models, state controller, and initial feature screens
- add core feature screens for spending, expenses, savings, and together budgeting
- add initial feature screens for savings, spending, budgeting, and dashboard
- add core feature screens and home shell navigation
- add savings and spend screens
- enhance expense tracker with improved display and color coding for expenses
- add core feature screens and home navigation shell
- add expense tracker screen and agent configuration files
- implement core feature screens for savings, spend, budget planner, and expense tracker
- add home shell, savings screen, and budget AI assistant components
- implement spend screen for logging and batching expenses
- add feature screens and tests for profile, spend, budget, and expenses
- add budget planner and expense tracker screens
- implement core app controller, feature screens, and related test suites
- add midnight auto-reset, date sync, savings screen, and app controller state logic
- add core budget services, state controller, feature screens, and tests
- implement app controller, expense tracker, and profile settings screens
- add core budget models, state controller, feature screens, and tests
- implement core models, state management, UI feature screens, and midnight reset tests
- add core app controller, feature screens, and budget lock and confirmation tests
- add core state management, budget planner, profile settings, and test suites
- implement local budget repository, profile settings screen, models, and tests
- add PowerShell script to automate OTA release preparation and versioning
- implement in-app OTA update service and core user interface screens
- implement core feature screens for authentication, budgeting, profile settings, and collaborative planning
- implement budget together, expense tracker, and spend management feature screens
- implement PDF and CSV financial report generation service and add supporting screens
- implement ProfileSettingsScreen and update run script
- implement platform storage integration and core budget model definitions
- add BudgetBuddyController state management and initial UI screens for planning, settings, and shared budgets
- add expense tracking and spending management screens for Budget Buddy
- implement profile settings screen for user preferences, theme toggling, and data management
- implement savings tracking screens for daily and monthly breakdown analysis

### Fixes & Improvements
- upgrade Gradle to 8.14, configure buildDir for Flutter, and fix batch script stability tweaks

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cjaayy/Budget-Buddy/commits/v1.5.5
